thesis: GMAB is a post-gap, extended, richly valued name bought on an unexplained catalyst, in a risk-off tape. The +28% gap on 10/28 (29.3M shares) and the spikes on 10/05 and 10/23 have no identified driver because the news feed was down, so the trade rests on a catalyst nobody has verified. Price has faded from the 59.97 high, and the pre-market indication of 52.77 (about -2.4%) is unexplained and already sits near the 52.6 floor of the entry zone, close to the 50.8 stop. Valuation is rich (trailing P/E 46.2, forward 34.2) while earnings growth is negative against positive revenue growth, and growth acceleration cannot be verified because the SEC series is empty. If the catalyst was a one-off, the 44.67 pre-gap level and the SMA20 at 47.73 are within reach, and the stock is 13% above that SMA20. The news leg is unverified rather than benign, so this is not a dealbreaker on current evidence but needs a manual headline check before any sizing.
